name: Are there financing options or grants available for wheelchair accessible home modifications?

mainEntity.name: Are there financing options or grants available for wheelchair accessible home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: While City Dweller, LLC does not directly offer financing or grants, various programs exist that may assist with the cost of wheelchair accessible home modifications. These can include state-specific programs for seniors or individuals with disabilities, grants from non-profit organizations, and sometimes assistance through veterans' benefits. It's recommended to research local and national resources or consult with an occupational therapist who may have knowledge of available financial aid options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing and grants for accessible modifications may be available through state programs, non-profits, or veterans' benefits; research local and national resources for options.
